protocol: Eight held-out synthetic employer demands, independently authored relevance judgements. Same32synthetic portfolio records used for UI and benchmark; no human hiring outcomes. Labels based on task suitability rubric, not algorithm score. Relevance2and3countpositive. Grade0: crucial competence absent;1: substantial gap requiring supervision;2: usable fit with non-critical gaps;3: strong fit. Weights fixed before measurements. Labels are author judgements, not an independent external expert panel.
